howto:
How it works

What you can do

  • Get region suggestions that fit your interests
  • Search by place, spot or map
  • Weather, best season and budget at a glance, plus an itinerary from your favorites

Three easy steps

  1. Choose a destination
  2. Enter your conditions, or search / use the map to pick a region
  3. Star the spots you like and build your itinerary
sec: 1Trip and partyLength, party and experience
3Preferences (1 = don't mind, 5 = important)Rate what you like, 1 to 5
first_info: Choosing “first trip” ranks regions with many must-see sights higher. “I've been before” skips that boost and favors regions that fit your tastes and conditions.

tx.condsub: Enter your days, budget and interests, then press the button.
tx.p2title: Find the destination that suits you
tx.empty: Press the button to see your results here.
tx.msub: Tap a region to see all of its spots.
tx.psph: Search places or spots (e.g. Taipei, Kyoto)
tx.hsub: Find a place to stay around “{spot}” ({reg}). Choose a booking site to open a search for the area “{term}” in a new tab.
tx.hnote: The search term is copied automatically when you open a site; paste it if the search box is empty. Search pages may change depending on each site.
tx.tbl_hint: Click a category to open its list of spots.
tx.fav_sub: Spots you saved with the star button. They are kept in this browser, so they will still be here next time.
tx.fav_empty: No favorites yet. Press the star button on a spot to add it here.
tx.share: Copy a link to this result
tx.share_hint: The link contains your conditions, so anyone who opens it sees the same result.
tx.cmp_hint: The highest value in each row is shown in gold.
tx.why_none: No single standout reason (it reflects your overall profile)
tx.model1: Your conditions are fed to a scikit-learn model trained in this app ({algo}), which computes the probability of each region. The top 5 are shown.
tx.model2: “Why this region” measures how many points the match drops when that condition is replaced by an average value.
tx.model3: Accuracy on held-out data: top-1 {t1} (chance {r1}) / top-3 {t3} / top-5 {t5}.
tx.season_note: A general guide based on typical climate. Check official sources for actual weather and events.
tx.title: Taiwan, at your own pace.
tx.desc: From night-market aromas to lantern-lit old streets — find the Taiwan that fits what you love.
